record.reason: This paper gives a theoretical and practical review of generative masked language models, their capabilities and limitations. Non-autoregressive generation is relevant to the linked sequence-modeling family, but the paper is not itself an efficiency method or a demonstrated inference accelerator.
record.title: Promises and Pitfalls of Generative Masked Language Modeling: Theoretical Framework and Practical Guidelines
